meta.name: aed:share-default
meta.description: Comma-separated default network list applied to share elements that don't override it. Available networks: twitter, bluesky, linkedin, facebook, reddit, hackernews, whatsapp, email, copy. No third-party scripts — URLs are built client-side.

data.description: Per-element share button row. Renders one icon per requested network.

data-aed-share.description: Comma-separated network override (falls back to the page-level default). Empty = use default.

data-aed-share-url.description: URL to share. Defaults to the current page URL.

data-aed-share-title.description: Title to share. Defaults to the document title.

data-aed-share-text.description: Body text (used by email, twitter, etc.).

data-aed-share-label.description: Optional prefix label rendered before the icons (e.g. 'Share:').
